title: GitHub gate audit @ a1549a6d
method: Every action op on main executed in-process with a mock fetch (no network) to capture method+URL for all calls (3 response modes); 58 declarative ops read from manifest.request. Captured routes matched to OpenAPI path templates. Each gate slug matched by lineage route (method+path, or GraphQL root field for GraphQL-surface slugs) against captured routes, not by name. fixtures/composio-coverage.json on main used only as a cross-check.
